points.description: Identifies the reactor as the completely mixed flow reactor (CMFR), also accepted as continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR), mixed flow reactor or complete-mix reactor.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the answer is on the right track but vague, e.g. 'mixed reactor' or 'stirred tank reactor' without 'flow' or 'completely'.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming a completely mixed flow reactor in any wording, including CMFR, CSTR, complete-mix or stirred tank reactor. Give 1 mark for a vague answer that points to mixing or stirring but is not clearly the right reactor. Give 0 for plug flow, batch or other unrelated reactors.
